    Pieces of bounded representation length are representation-finite #

    A module map between representations respecting the cover is a morphism whose total map is the module map (homOfLin_tot). So indecomposable representations give indecomposable modules (indNT_toFDMod), and isomorphic modules give isomorphic representations (iso_of_isoM). With finite_of_bounded this shows that a connected convex piece whose indecomposable modules have bounded dimension is representation-finite (pieceRepFin_of_bounded); hence a representation-infinite one has indecomposables of every size (unbounded_of_not_pieceRepFin), and so has its preprojective component.

    (Rep.Hom.tot (homOfLin s)) x = s x
